newsitem.title: RUSSIA: PRESS DIGEST - RUSSIA IZVESTIA - MAY 28.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - RUSSIA IZVESTIA - MAY 28.

text.p: Following are some of the leading stories in the May 29 edition of Russia's Izvestia newspaper. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Experts have registered a tendancy towards increasing foreign investment flows and slowed capital flight in Russia over the last few months, the paper says
- Sixty two industrial financial groups, including more than 60 banks and bank holdings, have been registered in Russia since January 1996
- The government seems to have approved the idea of creating an investment consortium by some leading commercial banks to finance government projects, the head of National Reserve Bank of Russia said
- The situation at Norilsk Nikel is slowly improving, says the daily

- Boris Yeltsin's initiative on retargeting Russian nuclear warheads away from NATO nations may in future be linked with the unsolved issue of possible future membership of NATO for the Baltic republics, Izvestia's analysts said.
